checklist.text: Generators or UPS, what they serve and how they are tested
Each boiler's type, fuel and pressure, where it sits and how it is separated, and its combustion safeguards and inspection records
Fuels on site (gas, oil, LPG), how much is stored and where, and their emergency shut-offs
What the site is used for, its operating hours and occupancy
Refrigeration plant and its refrigerant, chillers, and cooling towers with their construction and whether combustible fill is protected
Each transformer's type, rating, oil or dry type, and separation from buildings
Check server and comms rooms: separation, detection and suppression

observations.note: tenant server room L5, approx 40 racks. UPS room next door, VRLA batteries. diesel genset at roof, 2 x 2000 kVA, day tank 1000 L, tested monthly on load per FM
FM-200 in server room, last discharge/room integrity test 2023 - over due. no VESDA, only point smoke detectors
multi-tenant office, ~4000 occupants. building ERP exists, reviewed 2025, fire drill twice a yr. no BCP for the building itself - left to tenants. server room tenant has own DR site
tenant fit-out works on L30 under hot work permit, fire watch posted, extinguisher at hand
